summary: AISDLC-846: add a gates.yaml entry wiring pnpm lint:publishable (check-publishable-package-configs.mjs) into pnpm test, as the release-flow docs already claim

options.description: add the entry citing this decision
keep lint:publishable out of pnpm test and fix the docs instead

body: gates.yaml requires a decision id for every ADDED entry. The task file said no record was needed (class a, derived from the 2026-10-13 CI/CD audit), but the gate registry convention wants an id. Five-step: requirement questioned (the docs state the lint gates pnpm test; make the stated property true); nothing deleted; simplify (one test-chain entry); accelerate (fails locally before CI); automate (the chain entry). Tightening: class (a). Separate note: sign-attestation 14/15 + verify-attestation older-runtime fail locally on main = DEC-0173 local-only set.
